summary: Iter 21 — Security hardening (SEC-001/002/003), site settings, test-data purge, dashboards, public pricing from catalog, mobile PWA session/contact/install. Backend 24/24 pytest PASS (new file test_iter21_security_settings.py). Frontend: all critical flows verified. Client token now correctly gets 403 on /api/v1/admin/*, /api/v1/ai/draft-quote, /api/v2/projects while /api/v1/client/dashboard=200. /api/seed and /api/v1/seed removed (404). GET/PUT /api/v1/site-settings works, defaults 30/30/40 + accent_walls 50/50 + 'Projets de moins de 500 $' note confirmed. PUT rejects non-100 totals (400) and missing default (400); roundtrip + restore OK. Admin /api/v1/admin/test-data preview finds TEST_iter21 client; purge with scoped ids deletes only own items. /api/v1/admin/stats and /ceo-dashboard return clean metrics (test data excluded, revenue_by_month=6 months). Public filtering clean on /api/v2/catalog/public, /blog, /policies-public, /pricing-public, /social-posts (no TEST_, Playwright, /example leaks). Home: no RBQ anywhere, hero-deposit='Paiement 30/30/40', deposit-title/deposit-text/footer-insurance rendered, 3 testimonials from settings, clients-count/google-reviews-link/google-rating correctly hidden by default. /services exposes from-price badges for all 7 cats (painting, renovation, maintenance, furniture, demolition, hvac, accent_walls) + 'Sur devis' fallback. Subpages catalog-price-list render with catalog-item-* + payment-terms-* notes. /services/demolition shows from-price-demolition. /murs-accent shows 4 model cards 'Sur devis' + payment-terms-accent_walls (50/50). /soumission has hvac/tech/maintenance options + preselect via ?service=hvac. /conditions terms-step-0..2 render dynamically from settings; /faq payment answer references 30/40. Admin /admin/site-settings page fully functional: terms-default-percent-0..2, terms-total-default, terms-accent_walls-percent-0/1, terms-new-service + terms-add-service, review-0..2 + review-add, reviews-google-url/rating/count, trust-insured/clients-count, site-settings-save, test-data-cleanup block w/ test-group-{clients,leads,projects,invoices,quotes,blog_posts,policies,pricing_items,service_catalog}, test-data-purge. AdminLogin no longer shows 'Initialiser les données de démo'. Mobile PWA: session-expired → /m/login?expired=1 shows m-login-expired banner (verified by setting bogus localStorage token + hitting /m/leads); m-load-error renders for nonexistent /m/projects/:id (no infinite loader); m-contact-missing + aria-disabled=true + pointer-events-none on Call/SMS/Email actions when phone='0000000000'/placeholder; GPS stays active with real address; m-project-progress shown; /m/plus m-more-install click reveals m-install-help with iPhone/Android instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec expects data-testid='service-card-hvac' and 'service-card-tech' on /services for Climatiseurs & TV/Tech cards. Found only generic 'service-0'..'service-7' testids. Pricing badges from-price-hvac and from-price-installation-tech ARE present. Users CAN still see & click the cards. Just testid naming mismatch.

action_items: (LOW) Rename /services new service cards testids to 'service-card-hvac' and 'service-card-tech' to match spec (currently 'service-6'/'service-7'-ish).
critical_code_review_comments: staff_guard in server.py uses path-prefix matching (_is_staff_path) which correctly covers /api/v1/admin/*, /api/v1/ai/*, and all /api/v2/* except public login/refresh/catalog — tested 403 for client tokens, 200 for admin.
routers/site_settings.py has clean validation: enforces default rule presence + sum(percent)==100 per rule set, otherwise 400. DEFAULTS merged with persisted doc on GET.
routers/test_data.py purge only deletes ids present in detected candidates (intersection with allowed set), preventing arbitrary deletion of production rows via POST — good safety invariant.
services/test_data.py excludes TEST_, Playwright, @example.com, 'Test Service', 'Updated Title', urls with /example — comprehensive patterns.
server.py _payment_events computes CEO monthly_revenue from payments[] with fallback for legacy fully-paid invoices — correct for calendar-month comparison.
MMore.jsx is mounted at route 'plus' (/m/plus) — spec text sometimes says 'Plus > Installer' which could be read as /m/more. Confirmed path is /m/plus and works.

ContactActions.jsx validPhone/validEmail/validAddress correctly flag placeholders ('0000000000','5555555555','@example','à confirmer','n/a' etc). GPS action stays active for real addresses even when phone/email are missing — matches UX intent.
useLoad.js silently swallows 401 (no toast), relying on axios interceptor to redirect to /m/login?expired=1 — verified working. Non-401 shows toast + m-load-error. Good.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (every spec item verified except service-card-hvac/tech testid naming)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter21_<run>@example.com client via POST /api/v1/client/register, then purged via POST /api/v1/admin/test-data/purge (scoped ids). No lingering test data. Site settings PUT roundtrip restored defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend security + settings fully regression-covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_security_settings.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview>). Note: Mobile 'Plus' page route is /m/plus (not /m/more). Service testids on /services are 'service-0'..'service-7' (not 'service-card-hvac'/'service-card-tech') — spec deviation only. Admin login still works post-iter20 refactor. Catalog admin UI did not visibly list 'Murs d'accent / Démolition / Climatisation' categories in current snapshot — may be because dropdown was closed; endpoint-level categories are confirmed via public from-price badges (from-price-demolition, from-price-hvac, from-price-accent_walls).
